column1: # Canonical quantity -> epistemic status. Drives doc_gates.sh GATE 5.
# The single source of truth for these statuses is the "Canonical quantities" table in
# reports/METHODS.md. This file is the machine-readable projection of that table, so the
# gate can check that every OTHER mention of a load-bearing number carries a status
# consistent with it. Add a row here when METHODS gains a quantity.
#   match  = literal substring to search for. For scientific-notation forms the gate
#            additionally requires the "x 10" that follows, so a bare "5.21" in prose
#            (a version number, a percentage) does not trigger.
#   status = exact | estimate   (the "proven" theorem rows are not numeric-comparable,
#            so they are deliberately not listed here)
# WHY THIS EXISTS: the 2026-08-01 seeded-defect calibration planted a Bonferroni
# denominator change (91 -> 81) and a corrupted digit in a 39-digit count. Both were
# caught, but by reviewers rather than by machine. GATE 1 catches corrupted digits via
# near-twin detection; this gate catches the other half — a number keeping its digits
# while silently changing epistemic status, e.g. an estimate promoted to "exact".

column3: C1-C5 space size, Knuth estimator, 95% CI 0.02%
